task.description: Validate OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 in docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md for completeness, testability, and consistency with existing requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Each MUST requirement has unambiguous, testable acceptance criteria
No contradictions with OIDC-F-01..04 or OIDC-12/13/14
OIDC-F-05 specifies the fallback behaviour when no hostname binding exists
OIDC-F-06 specifies what happens when the API call fails

result.summary: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 pass all 6 validation checks. Both requirements are complete, testable, specify fallback behaviour, are additive to OIDC-F-01, are security-safe, and all cross-references resolve.

issues.description: OIDC-F-01 table summary description ("The provider URL is read from VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY ...") does not reference OIDC-F-06 override. Not a logical contradiction — OIDC-F-06 explicitly declares env vars as compile-time fallbacks — but the table cell could add "(overridden at runtime by OIDC-F-06 when tenant-config API is available)" for completeness.

check_results.completeness: PASS — both requirements have non-vague descriptions and 4 concrete acceptance criteria each
check_results.testability: PASS — all criteria have observable HTTP/UI outcomes (HTTP status codes, Playwright interactions, fetch-call counts)
check_results.fallback_behaviour: PASS — OIDC-F-05 specifies default tenant config returned on unknown hostname; OIDC-F-06 specifies env var fallback with login still possible on API failure
check_results.no_contradiction: PASS — OIDC-F-06 is explicitly additive (env vars remain as compile-time fallbacks); behaviour is coherent with OIDC-F-01
check_results.security: PASS — public endpoint returns only Keycloak realm URL and client_id, both public OIDC information; no tenant UUIDs, no internal secrets; fallback prevents hostname-enumeration information leakage
check_results.cross_references: PASS — OIDC-12 verified at line 1587 of BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md; ADP-03 verified at line 2866; OIDC-F-01 verified at line 84 of BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md; OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 verified at lines 100 and 114

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a): implement OIDC-F-05 backend endpoint and OIDC-F-06 frontend startup logic
